text: タカと　いっしょに　がんばって　みよっかな？

structure.jp: タカと　いっしょに
がんばって　みよっかな？

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: がんばって　みよっ
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means to try doing it and see how it goes. みよっ is a casual clipped みよう, 'let's try'. がんばって　みよっ = 'I'll try doing my best'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end shows the speaker wondering to herself. みよっかな = 'maybe I'll give it a try'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: タカと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: と with いっしょに says who you do something with. タカと　いっしょに = 'together with Jon'.
